summary: Iteration 24: Verified all 4 new features - Resend email integration, Campus Reports, Dashboard Campus Switcher, and Mobile-optimized views. Backend: 13/13 tests pass (100%). Frontend: All UI features verified via Playwright.

test_results_by_feature.email_templates_list: PASS - GET /api/email/templates returns 5 templates (welcome, event_invite, password_reset, report, custom)
test_results_by_feature.email_send_welcome: PASS - POST /api/email/send with 'welcome' template sends email via Resend to delivered@resend.dev
test_results_by_feature.email_log: PASS - GET /api/email/log returns sent email history with id, to, subject, sent_at fields
test_results_by_feature.campus_comparison_report: PASS - GET /api/reports/campus-comparison returns 11 campuses with totals
test_results_by_feature.campus_comparison_date_filter: PASS - GET /api/reports/campus-comparison with date_from/date_to params works
test_results_by_feature.campus_detail_report: PASS - GET /api/reports/campus/{location_id} returns member_count, children_count, group_breakdown, monthly_trends
test_results_by_feature.dashboard_stats_all: PASS - GET /api/dashboard/stats without campus_id returns all campuses (26 members)
test_results_by_feature.dashboard_stats_filtered: PASS - GET /api/dashboard/stats?campus_id=loc_001 filters to that campus (6 members)
test_results_by_feature.pdf_export: PASS - GET /api/reports/pdf returns PDF file with correct content-type
test_results_by_feature.frontend_campus_switcher: PASS - Campus Switcher dropdown visible on dashboard for admin, shows 11 campuses
test_results_by_feature.frontend_campus_filter_indicator: PASS - 'Viewing: {campus}' indicator and 'Show All' button appear when filtered
test_results_by_feature.frontend_campus_reports_page: PASS - /campus-reports page loads with totals, bar chart, and 11 campus cards
test_results_by_feature.frontend_campus_detail_view: PASS - Clicking campus card shows detail with pie chart and 6-month trends
test_results_by_feature.frontend_pdf_email_buttons: PASS - PDF and Email buttons visible on Campus Reports page
test_results_by_feature.frontend_mobile_hamburger: PASS - Hamburger menu button visible on mobile (390x844)
test_results_by_feature.frontend_mobile_sidebar: PASS - Mobile sidebar opens when hamburger clicked, shows Campus Reports nav link
test_results_by_feature.frontend_mobile_responsive: PASS - No horizontal overflow on mobile dashboard and campus reports pages
test_results_by_feature.frontend_mobile_grid: PASS - Stats cards use 2-column grid on mobile, campus cards stack vertically

critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: Resend email integration uses RESEND_API_KEY from env, sends via resend.Emails.send()
VERIFIED: Email templates (welcome, event_invite, password_reset, report) generate proper HTML with 58:12 branding
VERIFIED: Email log stored in db.email_log with resend_id, sent_by, sent_at fields
VERIFIED: Campus comparison aggregates members, children, families, donations, expenses, events, checkins per location
VERIFIED: Campus detail includes group_breakdown (pie chart data) and monthly_trends (6 months of donations/expenses/checkins)
VERIFIED: Dashboard stats endpoint accepts optional campus_id param, system admins can filter, non-admins see only their campus
VERIFIED: DashboardPage.jsx has isSystemAdmin check for campus switcher visibility
VERIFIED: CampusReportsPage.jsx has date filters, PDF/Email buttons, bar chart, and clickable campus cards
VERIFIED: Layout.jsx has mobile-menu-btn with hamburger icon, sidebar transforms on mobile
VERIFIED: All pages use responsive Tailwind classes (grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4, sm:flex-row, etc.)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing 11 locations for campus reports testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 24 complete. All 4 new features verified: (1) Resend email integration at /api/email/send with templates (welcome, event_invite, password_reset, report), /api/email/templates, /api/email/log - uses RESEND_API_KEY from backend/.env, (2) Campus Reports at /campus-reports with comparison view (bar chart, totals, campus cards) and detail view (pie chart, 6-month trends), (3) Dashboard Campus Switcher for system admins - dropdown in header filters /api/dashboard/stats by campus_id, shows 'Viewing:' indicator, (4) Mobile-optimized views - hamburger menu, responsive grids, no overflow. Previous iterations 22-23 had 100% pass rates.
rca_of_issue: No issues found. All requested features are working correctly.
